description: Defines an interface 'UserInformation' that encapsulates user-related data such as default subject and list of subjects, with JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: UserInformation
classes.description: An interface representing user data with methods to access default subject and list of subjects, including JSON serialization.

classes.name: UserInformation.JsonFields
classes.description: A utility class containing JSON field definitions for UserInformation properties.

methods.name: getDefaultSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the default subject of the user, if available.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of all subjects associated with the user.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the UserInformation object into a JSON object, considering schema version and field selection.
